task.question: How many people were killed when a crane collapsed onto a passenger train in Thailand on 14 January 2026?
task.evidence: 14 January – A crane collapses onto a passenger train in Sikhio district, Nakhon Ratchasima province, Thailand, killing at least 32 and injuring at least 67 others.
task.sonnet_answer: At least 10 people were killed when a crane collapsed onto a passenger train in Thailand on 14 January 2026.

answer:
On 14 January 2026, a construction crane fell onto a passenger train in Sikhio district, Thailand, killing 30 people and injuring 69 others. 

FINAL: 30
